narrative.overview: The current system transfers the owner-approved visual reference at http://xd.200.165.236.194.sslip.io across the existing application. The pinned reference is the visual authority; source CSS defines implemented values. This is a compact working interface with warm dark surfaces, orange accents, grouped navigation and quiet borders, with a corresponding light theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, labeled working panels and tables.
Geometric headings with neutral interface text and monospaced financial values.
Limited existing imagery, subordinate to readable data.

rules.name: The Reference Rule
rules.body: Keep the approved reference authoritative for visual decisions; do not revive archived concept tokens as current values.

dos: Do use the approved reference and current theme tokens for shared chrome and working surfaces.
Do preserve current Auth, ACL, real data, payroll formulas and saved layout behavior.
Do reuse existing imagery and keep content readable in both themes and at mobile widths.
Do label the static countdown as the Moscow-time game schedule.
donts: Don't treat historical concept palettes or typography as the current system.
Don't introduce fake translations, balances, levels, roles or unavailable features.
Don't present the static rotation as database events or automatic attendance.
